criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Nine genuinely different techniques, not one drawing re-argued. Frame 4's single specular line along the block's top edge and frame 8's cord through the hole are real drawing with real light and real dark, and frame 8's technique is unswappable from its claim. Detail is budgeted. Against it, and it is a third of the deck: frame 7 is three small primitives on a hairline with the top 40 percent empty, frame 9's right half reads as haze rather than as the empty bench the hook names, and frame 5 is the one frame that would fit another story.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. The ten item rejected list is unusually disciplined, refusing an award set for label misalignment across fetches, a production tonnage for run together columns and two quotes because two fetches disagreed on where the sentence ends. Three universals declared including two the regular expression never matched. Two shortfalls: slide 3's quotation stops mid clause inside a closing quote mark with no ellipsis, and the published item's evidence block carried four quotes none of which contained the word magnet.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A Texan who swipes all nine leaves knowing real things and frame 2 is the right Texas move in the right place. The funder is never stated as a FUNDER on any frame. Frame 8 is the money frame and it hangs both figures under two university names with nothing saying where the money came from. Harris is in the record and on no frame. No deadline and no door, correctly, because the record carries none.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe and reads at thumb size in under a second. Frame 5 re-presents frame 1's five percentages as a ruled table and adds one quote, and frame 7 is the thinnest in the deck sitting exactly where the deck should be accelerating. Four of nine frames are context before the docket item starts.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: The hooks are plain declarative American with no boosterism and no doom, and Neither page reconciles them and neither does this is the best line here. Regional specificity is where it goes flat: Houston appears twice across nine frames and nothing else places this in Texas.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Against decks 11 through 15 the palette break is real and tags on a drilled specimen is a technique this series has not run. The opening move is the documented break and it matters, because four consecutive angle notes asked for a deck whose spine is a thing somebody did and this cover opens on matter and a measured quantity. The brown grain substrate under five frames is house furniture and the deck still ends on an absence.

one_sentence_fix: Put the funder on frame 8 in the deck's own plain words, because that is the frame a reader remembers and it currently hangs both figures under two university names with nothing saying a federal agency paid either of them.
